messages:
deploy-bot: 🚨 Canary blocked for release/artifact feature-x:20260321-rc2 — missing SBOM attestation and cosign signature for multi-arch manifest. Gate: compliance.sbom+sign

alex: Ugh, timing. This release was supposed to go during the 10-12 UTC change window. Is this a build issue or signing backlog?

priya: CI shows artifact pushed but signing job retried/queued. Looks like the external sig-service had a transient 503. I can request priority, but EU change window is tight.

marcus: If signing is delayed, we should decide: wait for attestation (risk missing window) OR proceed with a scoped canary to non-EU regions and hold EU until evidence. Thoughts?

jenna: scoped canary sounds fine. We need an explicit fallback policy in release notes. Also we should add an audit note: which commits and which images were signed later.

alex: Agreed. Priya, can you escalate signing for the image digest? If we get cosign sig within 20m we can keep full rollout. If not, do staged carveout.

priya: Escalated to sig-ops, pinged security-sig-team. ETA ~15m.

security-sig-team: Noted. We see a retry storm from cross-region replication causing rate limits on the signer. We can prioritize this one if you mark it high. Confirm you want a manual expedite.

alex: Yes please expedite. Label: release/urgent-sign. Also add a release-note blurb: "EU rollout may be delayed pending attestation".

jenna: Adding PR note now: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/342 (draft). Will add a short TTR note and fallback instructions.

marcus: In parallel, can we create a digest-pin quick-fix in case signature never appears? Something like:
```bash
redwoodctl artifact pin --repo=release --name=feature-x --digest=sha256:abcdef123456 --region=eu --staged=10
```
That lets us pin a previously-signed base image while we re-run signing for the new build.

priya: That works but we need legal/qa signoff for pinning an older digest. It changes provenance.

security-sig-team: Legal OK with timeboxed pin if you attach audit trail and limit to 4 hours. We'll also run an integrity compare with the freshly-signed manifest once available.

alex: OK — plan: 1) wait 15m for expedited signing; 2) if not signed, apply EU carveout via deploybot (staged rollout to non-EU only) and pin fallback for EU for max 4h with QA signoff; 3) once signature arrives, re-unfreeze EU and push signed manifest, then reconcile audit entries and update release notes.

jenna: I'll post the rollout change in #release-war-room, update the PR, and annotate the changelog entry with the fallback plan.

priya: Signing completed — cosign sig attached to manifest sha256:abcdef123456. Deploybot, please re-run gate.

deploy-bot: ✅ Gate re-check passed. Canary resumed and full rollout scheduled per change window. Notes: cosign:0.11.2, sbom:v1.2 attached.

alex: Excellent. Thanks all. We'll keep the audit docs and timeline in the release ticket. :thumbsup:
